programme.title: Boligjakten: Episode 902
programme.desc: Amalie Snøløs drømmer om å kjøpe et oppussingsobjekt! Men har hun egentlig tid til det? Solfrid og André har spurt Hans Christian om hjelp til å finne drømmehuset, men ikke for enhver pris.

programme.title: Boligjakten: Episode 904
programme.desc: Positivitetsblogger Petter ønsker å bo nærmere sentrum, men klarer Karianne å finne den perfekte guttebula? Camilla og Jon Erik trenger mer plass og får hjelp av Hans Christian.

programme.title: Boligjakten: Episode 905
programme.desc: Iselinn og Ron er helt uenige om hvor de vil bo. Klarer Karianne å løse en tilnærmet umulig oppgave? Gårdsguttene Kim og Ole Johnny er på jakt etter et idyllisk gårdsbruk med skog og egen strandlinje.

programme.title: Boligjakten: Episode 906
programme.desc: Karianne får et viktig oppdrag med å hjelpe alenemamma Samia i hus før mammapermisjonen er over – men holder budsjettet? Hans Christian møter Johanna og Joakim som er på jakt etter drømmehagen.

programme.title: Boligjakten: Episode 1001

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Episode 517

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Episode 518

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Episode 519

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Episode 521

programme.title: Charterfeber: Episode 1001

programme.title: Charterfeber After Beach: Episode 105

programme.title: Charterfeber

programme.title: Charterfeber After Beach: Episode 104

programme.title: Charterfeber: Episode 908

programme.title: Charterfeber: Episode 1002

programme.title: Eventyrlig oppussing: Episode 507

programme.title: Forsidefruer: Episode 1108
programme.desc: Janni og Karstens kjære hund Lola skal opereres. Janni er veldig nervøs før inngrepet – spesielt når hun oppdager hvor ung veterinæren er.

programme.title: Forsidefruer: Episode 1001
programme.desc: Amalie har invitert alle fruene på lunsj for å møte lille baby Hannah for første gang. Alle gleder seg til å se hverandre igjen, men hvordan vil de håndtere Janni?

programme.title: Forsidefruer: Episode 1002
programme.desc: Tina og Allan har bestemt seg for å flytte tilbake til Danmark fra Dubai. I mellomtiden i Danmark har det som skulle vært en hyggelig lunsj for alle fruene hjemme hos Amalie gått overstyr.

programme.title: Forsidefruer: Episode 1003
programme.desc: Amalie sliter med å være både mor og ettertraktet influencer, så nå leter hun etter en barnepike som kan hjelpe henne. Vennen Janni stiller opp og sammen arrangerer de en annerledes audition.

programme.title: Forsidefruer: Episode 1004
programme.desc: Jackie og Rasmus har tatt turen til Bornholm for å feire sønnen Vicktors bursdag. Janni er klar for å få rumpa og magen skulpturert i en komplisert kosmetisk prosedyre.

programme.title: Luksusfellen Sverige: Episode 2705
programme.desc: Johan fra Helsingborg unnslipper følelsene sine ved å kjøpe dyre biler. Selv om han er sykemeldt på grunn av depresjon og utmattelse, fortsetter han å kjøpe ting som om det ikke finnes noen morgendag.

programme.title: Luksusfellen Sverige: Episode 2706
programme.desc: 25 år gamle Sanne fra Hjo har aldri vært bra oå økonomi, men da søsteren plutselig døde for drøyt et år siden, ga hun helt opp. Gjelden hoper seg opp, og hun klarer ikke å betale regningene sine.

programme.title: Luksusfellen Sverige: Episode 2707
programme.desc: Karl-Henrik fra Uppsala låner penger fra sin pensjonerte mor, som nå taper penger. Det blir en uke der mor Annie og Karl-Henrik blir nødt til å endre sitt syn på hverandre.

programme.title: Luksusfellen Sverige: Episode 2708
programme.desc: De unge foreldrene Simon og Andjela fra Luleå får snart sitt andre barn, men har fremdeles ikke mottatt noen foreldrepenger for sin førstefødte.

programme.title: Luksusfellen Sverige: Episode 2709
programme.desc: Fembarnsmoren, Catarina fra Bottnaryd, brenner broer til høyre og venstre som et resultat av hennes spilleavhengighet. Hun har mistet kontakten med flere av barna sine og holder nå på å miste huset sitt.

programme.title: Philomena
programme.desc: En livstrett politisk journalist tar opp historien om en kvinnes leting etter sønnen. Han ble tatt fra henne for tiår siden da hun ble gravid og ble tvunget til å leve i et kloster.

programme.title: Kapernaum
programme.desc: I en rettsal i Beirut står en 12 år gammel gutt. Dommeren: Hvorfor saksøker du dine egne foreldre? Zain: For å ha brakt meg til verden. Capernaum er en rørende og håpefull film, som gir en stemme til mange barn som faller utenfor.

programme.title: White Oleander
programme.desc: Den kompromissløse og forførende kunstneren Ingrid forgifter kjæresten sin i et anfall av sykelig sjalusi. Hun idømmes livsvarig fengsel og hennes 15-årige datter Astrid blir deretter kastet rundt mellom ulike fosterhjem.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Hired Gun
programme.desc: When three people were found murdered in their home, it appeared like a burglary gone awry. But a crime this horrific deserved a closer look.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Cat and Mouse
programme.desc: He was a predator, abducting girls and young women from their own front yards in broad daylight. He was a sadist: phoning one victim's family, taunting them, boosting then dashing their hope, and he wouldn't stop until we stopped him.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Cracking The Cartel
programme.desc: A mother and child are kidnapped a bystander is murdered. Violence such as this shattered a quiet Texas neighborhood and exposed a drug cartel that flourished where it was least expected.

programme.title: The FBI Files: A Stranger in Town
programme.desc: She appeared on the highway in the spring, a young woman, her life cut short, her past and her identity a mystery. Only by finding out who she was could we ever hope to find her killer.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Hunter's Game
programme.desc: In the 1970s and 80s, people went to Alaska looking for a fresh start, to reinvent themselves, or to disappear for a while. Some of those disappearances weren't by choice.

programme.title: 40 Days and Nights
programme.desc: When a colossal tectonic shift causes the sea level to start rising, a microbiologist gathers the DNA of as many species as she can, while the military creates an "ark" in a desperate attempt to preserve life on Earth.

programme.title: The Shamrock Spitfire
programme.desc: Den sanne historien om den irske jagerpiloten Brendan «Paddy» Finucane, som bare 21 år gammel ble tidenes yngste oberstløytnant i Royal Air Force, og som skvadronsjef et av de største og mest berømte flyveressene i andre verdenskrig.

programme.title: The Catcher Was A Spy
programme.desc: En uvanlig spion utfører en hemmelig oppdrag under andre verdenskrig, der virkelighet og bedrag konfronteres i en intens kamp mot fienden.

programme.title: Adventures of Aladdin
programme.desc: Aladdin is recruited to steal a magic lamp. But when he uses its powers to help him win the heart of the newly appointed Sultana, it opens up a whole new world of excitement and danger.

programme.title: 10 Items or Less
programme.desc: En kjent skuespiller, som ikke har takket ja til en rolle på fire år, vurderer nå en jobb. Regissørens kusine kjører ham ut av byen til en ranch hvor han vil drive research. På dette idylliske lille stedet blir han helt betatt av en av kassadamene.

programme.title: Humor Me
programme.desc: Humor Me er en varm far-sønn-komedie om en forfatter med skrivesperre som tvinges til å flytte inn sammen med sine vitsebesatte far i et pensjonistsamfunn i New Jersey. Der lærer han, som faren sier, at ”livet skjer, enten du smiler eller ei”.

programme.title: The Kids Are All Right
programme.desc: the kids are all right Mødrene Nic & Jules hadde den perfekte familien... helt til de møtte mannen som gjorde det hele mulig.

programme.title: The New Edition Story: Night Three
programme.desc: Da New Edition oppnår en suksess uten sidestykke, vil de endelig kunne legge alle uoverensstemmelser bak seg eller kommer deres uoppgjorte tvister til å føre til undergang?

programme.title: Being Mary Jane: Storm Advisory
programme.desc: Andre stilles ansikt til ansikt med David hos Mary Jane. Samtidig er forandringer i gang hos SNC. Når et anker blir sparket uten avskjed, blir Mary Jane, Kara og Mark urolige for jobbene sine.

programme.title: Being Mary Jane: Girls Night In
programme.desc: Mary Jane har en viktig samtale med Andre, og hun spekulerer over fremtiden. Det utvikler seg spenning mellom Kara og Mary Jane når Kara fikser på Marks forestilling og ei dame nærmer seg Paul sr.

programme.title: Being Mary Jane: The Huxtables Have Fallen
programme.desc: Mary Jane innser at realiteten bak affæren hennes er avslørt. En edruskapsfest driver Patrick til å reflektere over livet, og Mary Jane svarer til slutt Andre om frieriet.

programme.title: Boomerang: Pilot
programme.desc: New age markedsføringsproffene Bryson Broyer og Simone Graham vil skape sine egne spor for å lykkes samtidig som de vil ivareta foreldrenes arv: Graham-agenturet. En gang et firma som definerte industrien, men har mistet sin glans.

programme.title: Boomerang: Game Night
programme.desc: Bryson arrangerer en spillekveld for gjengen, men moroa forvandles snart til sjalusi når Simone konsentrerer seg om en uventet gjest. David og Crystal treffer hverandre for første gang siden skilsmissen.

programme.title: Boomerang: Power
programme.desc: Bryson prøver å få Victoria til å markedsføre en svart avantgardefilm. Simone leter etter muligheter for at Tia skal bygge varemerket sitt. Bryson tar tilbake makten fra Simone.

programme.title: Boomerang: Call A Spade
programme.desc: Simone, Crystal og Tia drar på en nattlig jentetur for å redde Simones sorgløse bestevenninne og kjæresten fra fengsel. Simone tar også hånd om sin skyld over Crystal og Davids skilsmisse.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Episode 306
programme.desc: En mystisk luftveisinfeksjon bryter ut i landsbyen.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Episode 307
programme.desc: På bryllupsdagen får brudepiken til Louisa konfetti i øyet; den lokale blomsterhandleren blir arrestert og blir tvunget til å stenge butikken sin.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Episode 401
programme.desc: Dr. Martin Ellingham og Louisa har tatt den hjerteskjærende avgjørelsen om å avlyse bryllupet deres.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Episode 402
programme.desc: Dr Martin Ellingham sliter med å takle Louisas nyheter. Men Louisa er fast bestemt på at hun ikke vil at Martin skal være involvert.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Episode 403
programme.desc: Dr. Martin Ellingham er overrasket over å finne Louise og Joan utenfor døren før åpningstid. Louisa er bekymret for at noe er galt og vil ha Martins bekreftelse på at alt er i orden.

programme.title: Hjemme i Hampstead
programme.desc: En amerikansk enke i London innleder et forhold til en mann som oppholder seg i Hampstead Heath, men en hensynsløs entreprenør vil få ham vekk derfra.

programme.desc: When a disturbed man takes a woman hostage outside an office building, the SRU is quick to respond to save the innocent hostage and bystanders caught in the crossfire.

programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show: Colleen & Tony
programme.desc: Colleen traff Tony på nettet og ble fullstendig forelsket. Selv om de aldri har sett hverandre i virkeligheten, fridde Tony over telefonen og Colleen sa ja! Nå må Nev og Max avsløre sannheten om mysteriemannen hun er forlovet med.

programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show: Open Investigation
programme.desc: Nev og Max tar tak i deres livs største sak når de jakter på den beryktede Shelly Chartier, for å avdekke nye sannheter om etterforskningen av Paris Roxanne og NBA-stjernen Chris "Birdman" Andersen.

programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show: Johnny & Connor
programme.desc: Nettkjæresten har vært borte i en måned, så Jonathon ber Nev og Max om hjelp med å finne ham. Men gutta oppdager at en tidligere catfish er involvert, og begynner å tro at Jonathon er med på bedraget!

programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show: Kelsie & Brandon
programme.desc: Sørstatsjenta Kelsie er dypt forelsket i nettkjæresten Brandon. Etter flere år med unnskyldninger om hvorfor de ikke kan møtes, ber Kelsie Nev og Max om hjelp til å etterforske hvem Brandon egentlig er.

programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show: April & Dean
programme.desc: April ble kjent med Dean i et chatterom for sju år siden da hun var 13 år gammel. I løpet av de årene kunne Dean plutselig bli borte i månedsvis av gangen. Nå trenger April å få hjelp av Nev og Max til å finne Dean før han forsvinner igjen!

programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show: Robert & Ashleigh
programme.desc: Robert ble lam som tenåring, og traff Ashleigh på nettet der de ble forelsket i hverandre. Nå har han fått vite at han ikke har lenge igjen å leve. Han ber Nev og Max om hjelp til å møte Ashleigh for å finne ut om kjærligheten var ektefølt.

programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show: Robin & Wayne
programme.desc: Etter tre lange år er Robin desperate etter å få møte sin kjekke online-kjæreste. Nev og Max sier seg villige til å hjelpe henne med å finne ham, men avdekker mye mer enn det hun hadde regnet med!

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: I Don't Hold Grudges... JK!
programme.desc: Det er en ny begynnelse for den ikoniske vennegruppen da de kommer tilbake til The Hills og tar opp kontakten etter mange år. Nye utfordringer, gamle feider og romanser kolliderer. Fortiden er nemlig ikke alltid i fortiden.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: You're Not My Family

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: A Legend in His Own Mind

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: Not to Eavesdrop, But to Eavesdrop

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: Playing with Fire

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: I Don't Think We Can Be Friends

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: Sjuhärad

programme.title: JAG: Silent Service

programme.title: Forensic Files: Duelling Confessions
programme.desc: When Rosemary Anderson is found dead on the side of the road, her boyfriend becomes the prime suspect. He eventually confessed to her murder, but so did another man: serial killer Eric Edgar Cooke.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Traces of Truth
programme.desc: A mysterious computer crash pushed a thriving manufacturing company to the brink of collapse, jeopardizing hundreds of employees' jobs. Forensic investigators must determine if the crash was the result of a computer defect, human error or sabotage.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Deadly Curve
programme.desc: It was supposed to be a routine motorcade for the Queen of England. But on the way to Yosemite National Park, a car carrying three Secret Service agents collided with a car driven by a deputy from the local sheriff's office.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Visibility Zero
programme.desc: In 1993, the Amtrak Railroad experienced the deadliest train crash in United States history when the Sunset Limited derailed while crossing Alabama's Big Bayou Canot bridge. 47 passengers and crew were killed; scores more were injured.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Flashover
programme.desc: A fire erupts in Kings Cross Station in London, killing 31 people and injuring dozens more. Investigators pinpoint the cause of the fire, but it takes state-of-the-art technology and fluid dynamics experts to explain why it became a deadly inferno.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Hack Attack
programme.desc: A mysterious computer crash pushed a thriving manufacturing company to the brink of collapse, jeopardizing hundreds of jobs. Forensic investigators had to determine if the crash was the result of a computer defect, human error, or sabotage.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Road Rage
programme.desc: Police investigate a discarded sleeping bag containing bloody sneakers and a purse, which eventually leads to the body of a young woman. A mark found on the victim's body enables police to track the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Hunter or Hunted
programme.desc: A woman is killed while walking her dogs in the woods. Since she has no enemies and her husband has an alibi, police assume it's a hunting accident — until they find a strange letter, allegedly written by the woman before her death.

programme.title: Forensic Files: In Harm's Way
programme.desc: An Alaskan police officer finds a woman's body while on routine patrol of a public park. During the autopsy, the medical examiner preserves the portion of her rib cage which sustained the fatal wound.

programme.title: Forensic Files: No Corpus Delicti
programme.desc: A woman disappears without a trace. Even though foul play is suspected, the leads don't pan out and the trail turns cold. Twenty years would pass before police are able to link a clump of hair discovered in an isolated area with the missing woman.

programme.title: The FBI Files: A Model Killer
programme.desc: It's a model's job to rivet the public's attention. But in 1984, some aspiring models began attracting publicity in a terrible new way.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Cop Killer
programme.desc: In 1995, our nation's capital was also our nation's murder capital. Even the police weren't safe. While Washington, DC, law enforcement targeted criminals, the criminals targeted law enforcement, even gunning down officers on patrol.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killer Instinct
programme.desc: In the early 1990's, a serial killer stalked lone victims in the dead of night, his hunting ground the suburbs of Washington, D.C., his target, anyone who owned a car.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Under Fire
programme.desc: A series of armored car heists and bloody shoot-outs shocked law enforcement. The brutal violence of the crimes suggested a motive more complex than greed. When the robbers started targeting police, the FBI took charge.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Threat
programme.desc: A suspected drug dealer would stop at nothing to keep local and federal authorities from building a case against him. When his organization started targeting the government itself, federal agencies went on high alert.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Family Secrets
programme.desc: A woman and her infant son vanish. The husband is frantic. The clues are scarce, but hopes linger, even as the hours and days tick by without a word. Was she on the run, or the victim of foul play?

programme.title: The New Detectives: Predators and Parasites
programme.desc: For the forensic entomologist, the insects that nest in dead bodies are like tiny witnesses to a crime.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Military Justice
programme.desc: The Naval Criminal Investigative Service uses forensic science to solve three perplexing murders and fulfill their motto: "To the living we owe respect; to the dead, we owe the truth."

programme.title: The New Detectives: Bodies of Evidence
programme.desc: It is difficult to convict a murderer if the body can't be found. But forensic science is finding ways to do it. Devious killers can think up many was to dispose of their victim's remains, but they are often no matches for investigators.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Deadly Target
programme.desc: Ballistics: A corpse is found with a gunshot wound to the head; the weapon lies next to the victim. It looks like suicide, but could it be murder? It's a question best solved by ballistics experts.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Loved To Death
programme.desc: A victim usually never foresees danger when the perpetrator turns out to be a friend or a lover. Science and microscopic evidence can unmask these killers and find justice for those who are Loved To Death.

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Steve, Get Him Out!
programme.desc: Kelly’s ex-husband Nikki continues to haunt her. He went to jail for killing her 2 week old son and is now dating her 18 year old daughter! Can Steve get Nikki out of their lives forever?

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: A Mother in Denial
programme.desc: When ordinary people need help, Steve Wilkos is ready to answer the call. Watch as Steve helps ordinary people stand up for themselves and fight for what he believes in order to promote justice for all.

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: A Mother's Rage
programme.desc: Three years later, Elizabeth still carries strong doubts about Manny's intentions with her family and her husband Rodney is caught in the middle. Is Manny innocent?

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Mommy Hurt Me
programme.desc: Stephanie’s drug addiction led her to neglect and abuse her kids. Scott’s fiancée stepped up as a mother and Stephanie failed multiple drug tests, he doesn’t want her near the kids, but wants her to atone for her wrongs!

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Who’s Hurting My Granddaughter?
programme.desc: Maria claims that her son’s ex Amy and her new boyfriend Brian are abusing and neglecting her granddaughter. But Amy says Maria is a racist and angry over raising her grandchild in a Hispanic home!

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: What Happened to My Baby?
programme.desc: Baby Garrett died of an oxycodone drug overdose while in Sharon’s care. His mother Casey left him with Sharon so she could visit her husband Kenneth in the hospital. Who’s responsible?

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Last Fare
programme.desc: A young man is found dead behind the wheel of his taxi. With robbery seeming unlikely, Kenda and Gaenzle wonder if this was personal.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Six Feet Under
programme.desc: Kenda finds the body of a bruised and battered young woman named Vicki Ross strangled. Kenda must sort through the endless suspicious characters in Vicki's past to find the elusive truth.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Blood From A Stone
programme.desc: A bystander receives a deadly head injury during a roadside altercation, but the stakes are raised when his body disappears from the scene. When a toddler is kidnapped for ransom Kenda joins forces with an undercover team in a desperate race against time.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Eyes of a Child
programme.desc: A loving, churchgoing grandmother is found stabbed to death in her apartment, leaving Joe Kenda to wonder what sort of monster could do such a thing.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: City Of Fear
programme.desc: When a spate of violent robberies spreads terror across the city, Kenda and the major crimes unit are called in to bring the masked gunman to justice.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: The Setup
programme.desc: Douglas Warren stumbles into a downtown bar with a gunshot wound to the neck and bleeds out on the floor. Kenda must conduct a risky sting operation and launch an interstate manhunt.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Science and the Shuttle
programme.desc: For more than 25 years the shuttle was our ticket to space, and our laboratory in orbit. Uncover the legacy of this amazing machine, and see what lies ahead.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Landing on Mars
programme.desc: Mars sparks our curiosity like no other planet because it is so reachable. Despite having landed there, most of the information we gather is still done by instruments in the planet's orbit.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Living with Space
programme.desc: Astronauts and Cosmonauts train and study for years to work and live aboard the International Space Station. With this wealth of experience and insight behind them what do they think when they return to Earth?

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Atmosphere
programme.desc: Our atmosphere is an unbelievably complex machine that protects us from the vacuum of space, shelters us from harmful radiation and allows us and the biosphere to breath; we need to learn much more about it so we can better it.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Flight Status
programme.desc: The next 12 months will see an intense rise in flight tests, demonstration launches and high priority flights. Some are on time others are not. We check the flight status of some of this new hardware and these new capabilities.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Invasion Mars
programme.desc: For over 50 years we have bombarded Mars with our probes and landers. Spying from orbit to map terrain, finding her strengths and weaknesses. The time nearing for the full scale invasion of the planet, when humans walk on Mars and claim it for their own.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Juno, Cassini and Beyond
programme.desc: The Amazing Cassini spacecraft and its sibling lander, Huygens, have now concluded their scientific studies, bringing back years of data. Now, Juno piercing the cloak of Jupiter and her distant relative New Horizons at the edge of the solar system.

programme.title: The Mystery of Dark Matter
programme.desc: Dark matter, which is unknown and undetectable in our physical models, would appear to populate the cosmos on a massive scale. For the first time, a film portrays the wild scientific quest that dark matter gives rise to - a real thriller!

programme.title: Trace of Evil: Tragedy in The Canyon
programme.desc: Trace of Evil: Tragedy in the Canyon is the disturbing story of Jchandra Brown, what happened in the moments leading up to her death and how investigators worked to establish the true facts.

programme.title: Trace of Evil: The Murder of Belen Perez
programme.desc: Trace of Evil: The Murder of Belen Perez follows the investigation into the death of an innocent mother, how detectives broke the case and how the guilt of the offender was eventually proven.

programme.title: Trace of Evil: The Perplexing Case of Kay Mortensen
programme.desc: Trace of Evil: The Perplexing Murder of Kay Mortenson is the story of a senseless murder and the unusual investigation that followed.

programme.title: Trace of Evil: Treacherous Encounter
programme.desc: Evidence of Evil: Treacherous Encounter is the story of the murder of Shannon Griffin and how an extensive police and forensics investigation revealed those responsible and brought them to justice.

programme.title: Trace of Evil: Terror in Tampa
programme.desc: Trace of Evil: Terror in Tampa is the story of the brutal and senseless murder of Sandra Rozzo, why and how she died, and how determined police work and forensic science eventually crack the case.

programme.title: iCarly: Chucks lillebror
programme.desc: Et sinna barn ønsker inderlig å hevne seg, men målskiven Spencer prøver iherdig å stoppe ham. Gibby blir knust når hans nye lekelaserpistol går i stykker, men blir fra seg av henrykkelse når Freddies reparsjion gir den overraskende krefter.

programme.title: iCarly: Utestengt
programme.desc: Når Carly bannlyser T-Bo fra hennes og Spencers hjem, hevner han seg ved å ikke slippe Carly inn på Groovy Smoothie. Imens oppdager Freddie og Gibby at det fins mange fordeler ved å spille i band...og også et par ulemper.

programme.title: iCarly: Turen til Las Vegas
programme.desc: Når Sam får vite at moren hennes er i fengsel i Vegas, bestemmer gjengen seg for å ta sine mest verdifulle eiendeler, kjøre til Vegas og pantsette dem - så de får nok penger til å betale borgen for henne. Gjesteartister: History Channels PAWN STARS.

programme.title: iCarly: Nattsynbrillene
programme.desc: Sams venn kommer ut av ungdomsfengselet, og Sam advarer alle om å holde seg unna, men Carly hører ikke etter og havner på dypt vann. Hjemme i leiligheten finner Spencer noen nattsynbriller.

programme.title: iCarly: Verden er rystet del 1
programme.desc: Jimmy Fallon inviterer iCarly-gjengen til å opptre live i programmet sitt i New York. De elsker New York og er kjempeglade for å være med i programmet, men alt kan skje på live tv.

programme.title: iCarly: Verden er rystet del 2
programme.desc: Jimmy Fallon inviterer iCarly-gjengen til å opptre live i programmet sitt i New York, men en stor klesmiss fra Gibby betyr store problemer for nettshowets fremtid.

programme.title: iCarly: Spencers venner
programme.desc: iCarly-gjengen vil finne venner til Spencer på hans egen alder. De finner noen gode muligheter, men vil vennskapet blomstre?

programme.title: iCarly: Den stjålne laptoppen
programme.desc: Når Sams laptop blir stjålet, prøver iCarly-gjengen å hjelpe henne med å oppspore tyven. Imens får Spencer vite at han ikke får komme inn i sin yndlingsspillehall hvis han ikke er i følge med et barn. Hellet snur når Guppy trenger barnevakt.

programme.title: iCarly: Farvel del 2
programme.desc: Carly er på vei til å akseptere at hun ikke kan gå på det årlige ballet, da faren hennes dukker opp og går sammen med henne. Kvelden tar en uventet vending når faren hennes stiller et livsavgjørende spørsmål.

programme.title: iCarly: Vårt eget webshow
programme.desc: Når Miss Briggs avviser alle yndlingsdeltagerne deres fra uttakene til talenshowet, bestemmer Carly og Sam seg for å lage sitt eget talentshow for klassekameratene gjennom iCarly på nettet.

programme.title: iCarly: Herr Nesten Perfekt
programme.desc: Carly er keen på en gutt på skolen som heter Jake. Han er råkul og kjekk, og fordi hun liker ham, inviterer hun Jake til å spille gitar og synge på sitt nye webshow. Men hun oppdager forsent at Jake synger helt forferdelig.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Bone Thugs And Homeless

programme.title: Key & Peele: Michael Jackson Halloween

programme.title: Key & Peele: Les Miz
programme.desc: Vi møter vikaren fra bykjernen Mr. Garvey og A-Aron, Jordans kjæreste tar ham i å se på porno og karene har det moro med Les Mis.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel Norge - Ny sesong!

programme.title: Paradise Hotel Norge - Ny sesong!

programme.title: Paradise Hotel Norge - Ny sesong!
programme.desc: Kjærligheten har inntatt hotellet, og en ny kjekkas sjekker inn. Jentene fristes, og et partnerskap slår sprekker.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel Norge - Ny sesong!

programme.title: Boligjakten: Episode 1004

programme.title: Boligjakten: Episode 1005

programme.title: Boligjakten: Episode 1006
programme.desc: Christian skal selge leiligheten han har arvet, og Karianne får derfor en helt ny utfordring! Vi møter også tidligere deltagere og får bli med inn i deres nye leiligheter, hus og gårdsbruk.

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Episode 521

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Episode 523

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Episode 524

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Episode 526

programme.title: Charterfeber: Episode 1002

programme.title: Charterfeber: Episode 1008

programme.title: Charterfeber: Episode 1007
programme.desc: Per og kjæresten Bahareh tar turen til badeland for å teste ut vannskliene. Fred Åge og kompisen Sven Erik drar på shopping. Aurora er tilbake på Gran Canaria sammen med moren Bibbi og søsteren Fleur.

programme.title: Eventyrlig oppussing: Episode 306

programme.desc: Richard Hammond og James May tester en Porsche Panamera mot det britiske postvesenet i et kappløp fra den ene enden av de britiske øyer til den andre.

programme.title: Forsidefruer: Episode 1004
programme.desc: Jackie og Rasmus har tatt turen til Bornholm for å feire sønnen Vicktors bursdag. Janni er klar for å få rumpa og magen skulpturert i en komplisert kosmetisk prosedyre.

programme.title: Forsidefruer: Episode 1005
programme.desc: Janni og Amalie vil arrangere et morsomt og festlig sosialt arrangement for alle fruene. Men hva skjer når Janni plutselig blir alene om arrangementet.

programme.title: Forsidefruer: Episode 1006
programme.desc: Karina og Gunnvør går til en klarsynt for å få redskaper til å bedre håndtere meningsforskjellene i vennegjengen. Samtidig feirer Janni og Karsten bryllupsdagen med et slottopphold.

programme.title: Forsidefruer: Episode 1007
programme.desc: Tinas planer om å dra til OL blir utfordret når hesten hennes er med om en ulykke. Karina og Tina bestemmer seg for å invitere alle fruene på et spaopphold på et nytt hotell.

programme.title: Forsidefruer: Episode 1008
programme.desc: Alle er travelt opptatt med juleforberedelsene. Det er Tina og familiens første ordentlige danske jul, og Janni har store planer om å arrangere en julelunsj for alle fruene på Vedbæklund.

programme.title: Luksusfellen Sverige: Episode 2709
programme.desc: Fembarnsmoren, Catarina fra Bottnaryd, brenner broer til høyre og venstre som et resultat av hennes spilleavhengighet. Hun har mistet kontakten med flere av barna sine og holder nå på å miste huset sitt.

programme.title: Luksusfellen Sverige: Episode 2801
programme.desc: Per og Jael har kastet bort hundretusenvis av kroner på tekniske duppeditter og luksusleker til barna sine. Nå kollapser hele familiens økonomi når en gjeld på 100 000 svenske kroner har havnet hos namsmannen.

programme.title: Luksusfellen Sverige: Episode 2803
programme.desc: Mikael har bygget seg opp en enorm gjeld gjennom en serie dårlige bilkjøp. Han handler på kreditt, men aner ikke hva renten er. Når alle regningene er betalt, har han ikke en gang råd til mat.

programme.title: Luksusfellen Sverige: Episode 2804
programme.desc: Bea og Robin handler altfor mye på impuls og avbetaling. Midt i det økonomiske stresset oppdager de hvor ulike de er, og nå risikerer de å gå hver til sitt.

programme.title: Luksusfellen Sverige: Episode 2805
programme.desc: Patriks problem startet for to år siden da han tok opp et lån til en bil som han ikke kjøpte. I stedet brukte han pengene på seg selv og levde mer luksuriøst enn vanlig.

programme.title: Luksusfellen Sverige: Episode 2806
programme.desc: For omtrent to år siden tok Leo opp et lån på 150 000 kroner til "litt av hvert". Før pengene tok slutt tok han opp et nytt stort lån, og så gikk det nedoverbakke - og moren orker ikke å hjelpe ham lenger.

programme.title: Kapernaum
programme.desc: I en rettsal i Beirut står en 12 år gammel gutt. Dommeren: Hvorfor saksøker du dine egne foreldre? Zain: For å ha brakt meg til verden. Capernaum er en rørende og håpefull film, som gir en stemme til mange barn som faller utenfor.

programme.title: White Oleander
programme.desc: Den kompromissløse og forførende kunstneren Ingrid forgifter kjæresten sin i et anfall av sykelig sjalusi. Hun idømmes livsvarig fengsel og hennes 15-årige datter Astrid blir deretter kastet rundt mellom ulike fosterhjem.

programme.title: Marmaduke
programme.desc: En stjernespekket rolleliste med Owen Wilson, George Lopez,Kiefer Sutherland og Fergie som låner ut stemmene sine tildenne bjeffende morsomme komedien med verdens søteste grand danois.

programme.title: What We Did on our Holiday
programme.desc: Doug og Abi er to vanlige foreldre med tre sjarmerende, men ganske sære barn. Når familielivet blir så slitsomt at det truer trivsel og troskap, bestemmer de seg for å ta med barna på tur til Skottland til en stor familiefest.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Hunter's Game
programme.desc: In the 1970s and 80s, people went to Alaska looking for a fresh start, to reinvent themselves, or to disappear for a while. Some of those disappearances weren't by choice.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Dixie Mafia
programme.desc: On Mississippi's Gulf Coast, a Judge and his politician wife are murdered in their home. The killer left few clues. It looked like a professional hit, and the investigation led nowhere. But the FBI refused to give up.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Shattered Shield
programme.desc: In a city awash in narcotics the drug lords have all the power even over the police. Corruption in New Orleans grew like cancer, eating away at public safety and threatening to destroy the city. Crooked cops break the laws they were sworn to uphold.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Blood Brothers
programme.desc: When the small community of Noel, Missouri discovered their bank was robbed, they're shocked. When the bank president turned up missing, they're outraged. And when clues began to surface the facts were more terrible than anyone could have guessed.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Crime Spree
programme.desc: They swept through six states like a plague, thrill killers acting without rhyme or reason. They targeted adults and young girls, kidnapping, and murdering. And in their rampage, they left plenty of clues, but moving targets are the hardest to hit.

programme.title: The Catcher Was A Spy
programme.desc: En uvanlig spion utfører en hemmelig oppdrag under andre verdenskrig, der virkelighet og bedrag konfronteres i en intens kamp mot fienden.

programme.title: Adventures of Aladdin
programme.desc: Aladdin is recruited to steal a magic lamp. But when he uses its powers to help him win the heart of the newly appointed Sultana, it opens up a whole new world of excitement and danger.

programme.title: Match Point
programme.desc: Chris Wilton er en ung og vakker men fattig tennistrener som involveres i en rik familie gjennom å trene en av familiemedlemmene. Kjærlighetsaffærer med to kvinner samtidig tvinger ham til å begå en alvorlig forbrytelse.

programme.title: Shattered Glass
programme.desc: Hayden Christensen spiller hovedrollen i denne kritikerroste sanne historien om en vanæret journalist, regissert og delvis skrevet av Billy Ray, den Oscar®-nominerte forfatteren av CAPTAIN PHILLIPS.

programme.title: The Kids Are All Right
programme.desc: the kids are all right Mødrene Nic & Jules hadde den perfekte familien... helt til de møtte mannen som gjorde det hele mulig.

programme.title: Weird: The Al Yankovic Story
programme.desc: Utforsker alle sider av Yankovics liv, fra stjerneskuddet med tidlige hits som "Eat It" og "Like a Surgeon" til hans brennende kjendisforelskelser og beryktede røffe livsstil.

programme.title: Marmaduke
programme.desc: En stjernespekket rolleliste med Owen Wilson, George Lopez,Kiefer Sutherland og Fergie som låner ut stemmene sine tildenne bjeffende morsomme komedien med verdens søteste grand danois.

programme.title: Boomerang: Call A Spade
programme.desc: Simone, Crystal og Tia drar på en nattlig jentetur for å redde Simones sorgløse bestevenninne og kjæresten fra fengsel. Simone tar også hånd om sin skyld over Crystal og Davids skilsmisse.

programme.title: Games People Play: Pilot
programme.desc: Nia blir forfremmet og flytter til Los Angeles, og forlater kjæresten Eric i New York. Vanessa og baskemannen Marcus kjøpes til Los Angeles med nyheten om at dama han hadde en affære med nå er borte.

programme.title: Games People Play: Lover's Moon
programme.desc: Nia intervjuer Laila om historien. Laila bekrefter at mannen på bildene er Marcus King. Nia informerer Vanessa om artikkelen som holder på å bli utgitt. Kareem forteller Marcus at Jamal sliter med spillegjeld.

programme.title: Games People Play: The Drink of Kings
programme.desc: Marcus og Vanessa gå til rådgiver. Nia og MJ kjemper for å komme seg etter tapet av Laila-historien. Laila arrangerer privatfester for Roxanne og blir venn med Susie Q. Susie inviterer Laila til en snobbete begivenhet.

programme.title: Being Mary Jane: Mixed Messages
programme.desc: En sannhet om Andre slår Mary Jane, og hun svarer med å møte en mann på nettet. Forandringer blir for mye for Mark. Helens diamantarmbånd forsvinner. Elte følelser angående Patterson-barna kommer for en dag.

programme.title: Being Mary Jane: Exposed
programme.desc: Paul sr. vil glede Helen med et platinabord uner en stor galla, hvor Mary Jane tilfeldigvis treffer David. MJ må fatte en stor avgjørelse på arbeidet.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Episode 403
programme.desc: Dr. Martin Ellingham er overrasket over å finne Louise og Joan utenfor døren før åpningstid. Louisa er bekymret for at noe er galt og vil ha Martins bekreftelse på at alt er i orden.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Episode 404
programme.desc: Dr Martin Ellingham blir tilkalt til Louisas nye hjem etter at hun nesten besvimte mens hun flyttet møbler.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Episode 405
programme.desc: En familie saksøker Joan etter at hun har sperret inn deres svært plagsomme barn i hønsegården.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Episode 406
programme.desc: Dr Martin Ellingham møter Portwenns nye jordmor, Molly, som skal ta seg av Louisa. Martin liker ikke yrket, og de finner ikke tonen med hverandre.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Episode 407
programme.desc: Dr Martin Ellingham oppsøker Louisa for å prate om sin nye kirurgjobb i London, men de blir avbrutt av Bert, som ønsker å planlegge en baby shower for Louisa.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Episode 408
programme.desc: Dr Martin Ellingham og Pauline er overrasket over antallet pasienter som kommer til ham den siste dagen før de stenger, og han flytter til London.

programme.title: Worth
programme.desc: Etter angrepene på World Trade Center og Pentagon utnevner kongressen advokaten Kenneth Feinberg til å lede erstatningsfondet for ofrene. Feinberg står overfor en umulig oppgave - å bestemme hvor mye et liv er verdt.

programme.title: I krig med bestefar
programme.desc: Peter er en vanlig gutt som går i 6. klasse. Han liker å game og henge med vennene sine. Men når bestefaren Ed flytter inn i familiens hus, blir Peter tvunget til å gi bestefar rommet sitt.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled
programme.desc: Country-sangerinnen Charlotte reiser hjem til Tennessee en uke før hun skal gifte seg, i håp om å låne sin avdøde mors brudekjole av bestemoren.

programme.title: Wildfire: Calm
programme.desc: Jean and Pablo are adamant that Kris leave town instead of sticking around and helping to care for Wildfire.

programme.title: Wildfire: Flames
programme.desc: Kris and Junior help Matt with his improbable plan to get Raintree back in the horse-racing business, which involves finding Wildfire's offspring, Flame.

programme.title: Wildfire: The Friend
programme.desc: Junior's preoccupation with his and Calvin's business proposition takes time away from his wedding plans, but Laura suspects his loss of focus may have something to do with Kris.

programme.title: Wildfire: Friendship/Passion
programme.desc: The pressure is on Junior to decide whether or not to go through with his wedding to Laura after he and Kris share a moment of passion.

programme.title: Wildfire: Commitment Issues
programme.desc: When it appears that Flame is ready for his first race, Kris decides to fight to get her jockey's license reinstated.

programme.title: Wildfire: Life's Too Short
programme.desc: Kris hopes that Flame's success in the DuPont Stakes might help Jean change her mind about Raintree's future, but Kris isn't so sure about what part---if any---she'll play in it.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Dead Aim
programme.desc: Ton & Allen face-off against an auction buyer with shady bidding tactics and even more questionable fashion sense. The guys find a custom-built monowheel & a rifle designed to ward off grave robbers in the early 19th century!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Strat'ed for Cash
programme.desc: On a limited budget in the historic L.A. neighborhood of West Adams, Allen and Ton still win three lockers and find a Maui Blue Fender Stratocaster and a 1930s Schwinn bike.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: The Chicago Grand Slam
programme.desc: 1984 Yamaha SS440 Snowmobile that introduced the revolutionary shock absorber suspension; rare autographed 1920s baseball glove; mint Hank Aaron signed baseball; authentic 1950s Robby the Robot collector toy.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: The Jersey Score
programme.desc: Ton & Allen attend a silent auction in NJ, but that doesn't stop the local buyers from letting them know they're not welcome! They uncover a skeet throwing machine from the 1960's & a vintage vehicle with some real horsepower!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Hula Moola
programme.desc: Ton and Allen jet to the Hawaiian islands where they're joined by a feisty new female assistant! The team uncovers a pair of James Bond-style gadgets designed for high-speed underwater travel and a vintage sled.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Friends in Hawaii Places
programme.desc: Allen &Ton enlist an assistant, Carolyn, and Allen's Hawaiian buddy, Junior, to help them battle local buyers. The guys find a WWII-era motor scooter and a stash of antique Polynesian tattoo tools that get used on Ton!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Home on the Gun Range
programme.desc: Barely making it to an auction in Corona, CA, Allen and Ton buy an overstuffed unit and find an antique crossbow, a rare 10-gauge Winchester shotgun and a 1940s Kiss-o-Meter.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: The Chi-Town Showdown
programme.desc: Metal Victorian-era burial casket; 1870s glass fire extinguisher grenades; a mechanical 1896 handcrafted Chicago fire station alarm box.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Quadzilla Attacks!
programme.desc: Extreme Quadzilla ATV, the fastest 4 wheeler ever; a 1910s Remington Derringer and an 1880s Palm Squeezer pistol; revolutionary 1800s Western Electric telephone with a crank dial.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Gangs of New York
programme.desc: Ton and Allen duke it out with a local thrift store gang at a Brooklyn storage auction. The guys discover a classic arcade redemption game and a mid-century water cannon designed to fight towering infernos!

programme.title: Merry Kissmas
programme.desc: Kayla og Carlton er på grensen til å slå opp, mest fordi Carlton behandler henne som sin assistent. Så har Kayla et spontant kyss med Dustin, og tror at hun endelig har møtt sin sanne kjærlighet.

programme.title: Christmas is You
programme.desc: En kontorassistent står overfor et dilemma når sjefen hennes ber henne overbevise ekskjæresten sin om å signere med labelen deres, eller se etter en ny jobb.

programme.title: Christmas Unfiltered
programme.desc: På julaften ønsker Becky at familien hennes virkelig skal høre henne. Alle tankene og frustrasjonene hennes renner ut når hun uforvarende begynner å fortelle alle hva hun egentlig tenker.

programme.title: A Furry Little Christmas
programme.desc: En veterinær fra storbyen faller for en provinslege når han prøver å gjenskape en New York-jul i hjembyen hennes i Vermont.

programme.title: Barely Lethal
programme.desc: 16-år gamle Megan Walsh trener for å bli leiemorder, men hun lengter etter å være en normal tenåring. Hun forfalsker sin død og melder seg som utvekslingsstudent. Megan finner raskt ut at man trenger unike ferdigheter for å overleve skolens intriger.

programme.title: Results
programme.desc: Personlige trenere (Cobie Smulders og Guy Pearce) blir gitt i oppdrag å få en nyrik og svært umotivert klient (Kevin Corrigan) i form. Deres tre liv blir raskt uløselig sammenknyttet, både profesjonelt og personlig.

programme.title: Tell It to the Bees
programme.desc: Jean Markham vender tilbake til byen hun en gang forlot som tenåring, nå for å overta farens legekontor. Ved en tilfeldighet møter hun Lydia og det oppstår følelser som ikke burde eksistere. Farlig kjærlighet i en liten by på 50-tallet i Skottland.

programme.title: Scorpion: Little Boy Lost
programme.desc: Når Walter ved et uhell blir skutt ut i verdensrommet i en rakett, hallusinerer han om Paige mens oksygenet hans går tom, og Team Scorpion jobber febrilsk for å finne en måte å få ham hjem før han blir kvalt.

programme.title: Scorpion: Little Boy Lost
programme.desc: Teamet må finne en gutt fra Ralphs klasse som forsvinner på en ekskursjon etter å ha støtt på en dødelig forbryter.

programme.title: Scorpion: Bat Poop Crazy
programme.desc: Team Scorpions enkle jobb ved Natural History Museum i Los Angeles blir dødelig når de oppdager tyver som raner en utstilling med sjeldne edelstener for å berike en atombombe.

programme.title: Scorpion: We're Gonna Need a Bigger Vote
programme.desc: Før Halloween må teamet infiltrere et dypt, enormt hulesystem for å hindre en flaggermusbestand i å ødelegge det nordamerikanske økosystemet.

programme.title: Scorpion: Sly and the Family Stone
programme.desc: På valgdagen, når demokratiet står på spill, blir Team Scorpion kalt inn når noen prøver å skape kaos i det amerikanske presidentvalget.

programme.title: Scorpion: Mother Load
programme.desc: Når Team Scorpion reiser til Irland for Megans ettårsjubileum, oppdager Walter at en naturkatastrofe i en innsjø i nærheten har skapt en giftig sky som kan drepe alle i landsbyen.

programme.title: Numb3rs: På kanten
programme.desc: Da en UFO blir sett farlig nær Los Angeles, ber Don Charlie om hjelp til å finne ut hvor det mystiske luftfartøyet kommer fra, og de blir overrasket når det viser seg å bli en drapsetterforskning.

programme.title: Numb3rs: Menneskejakt
programme.desc: I sesongavslutningen må Don finne to voldelige forbrytere som stakk av etter at fangetransporten deres havnet i en ulykke.

programme.title: Numb3rs: Snikmorder

programme.desc: Doktoren møter tidsherrene i en kamp som tar ham til tidens ende.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Siste håp
programme.desc: Walker, Alex, C.D. og Trivette tar en gruppe barn med på Ranger-leir for en helg, uten å vite at en av guttene har stjålet penger fra doplangere og satt dem alle i fare.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Full kontakt
programme.desc: Når Johnny Prado, en kickboksingmester, klandres av en fiende for drapet på manageren/treneren sin og dopbesittelse, tar Walker over som treneren hans for verdensmesterskapet i kickboksing.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Den 99. ranger
programme.desc: Walker hjelper en kvinne å realisere drømmen om å bli en Texas Ranger.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Djevelens territorium
programme.desc: Elever på videregående begynner å dø av ulykker forbundet med «powerballs», en kombinasjon av anabole steroider og metamfetaminer, blir Walker vikarlærer for å finne kulden til dopet.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Fordums dager
programme.desc: Når mannen som drepte Walkers forlovede ti år tidligere blir løslatt før tiden, overveldes Walker av vonde minner idet han søker rettferd for henne.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: LaRues rettssak
programme.desc: Alex møter sin nemesis Victor LaRue igjen. Denne gangen i en rettssal der han er hennes skjebnes selvutnevnte dommer, og kun Walker kan redde henne.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: Double Dead
programme.desc: Gangsters running a loan-shark racket in Hawaii short-circuit the IMF team's investigation when they capture Willy and feed him gigantic doses of truth serum.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: Casino
programme.desc: Guest star Jack Cassidy is Orin Kerr, an ex-hoodlum who now controls the largest gambling resort in the western hemisphere as a front for the underworld crime syndicate.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: Trapped
programme.desc: Jim Phelps is struck on the head and loses his memory while trying to intercept an eight-million-dollar smuggling operation.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: Break!
programme.desc: Carl Betz, Barbara Anderson, and Robert Conrad guest star alongside Jim Phelps who, with the aid of Barney's electronic wizardry, takes on the guise of a hot-shot pool hustler to break up an illegal gambling operation.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: Two Thousand
programme.desc: Joe Collins is a nuclear scientist who is made to believe that he is a prisoner in the year 2000 and is about to be executed as part of the IMF's plans to learn where he has hidden enough plutonium to construct a dozen atomic bombs.

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark: Episode 506
programme.desc: En liten leiebolig i Vanløse og to små barn - ikke den beste kombinasjonen. Lisa og Erling drømmer om et stort hus med en stor hage. Tobias må jobbe hardt, da drømmene er mye større enn budsjettet.

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark
programme.desc: Kristian drømmer om en diger garasje, og Nathja vil heller bli i Køge – kan Tobias oppfylle drømmene sine?

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark
programme.desc: Maja og Kenneth bor på Vestjylland og drømmer om å komme nærmere familien til Maja i Silkeborg. Men budsjettet deres krever at de går på akkord med beliggenheten og ser i de nærliggende små byene.

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark: Episode 603
programme.desc: I Ikast er Camilla og Marc sultne på et hus med plass til oppbevaring. Men når Tobias finner et stort hus til dem, mister de motet, da det nå er SÅ mange rom som må pusses opp...

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark: Episode 604
programme.desc: Stine og Daniel lengter etter mer plass før de snart utvider familien fra tre til fire. Derfor er det ikke optimalt når Mads ringer og forteller at avtalen med det nye huset deres i Langå ikke gjelder.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: Höganäs
programme.desc: The wild coast at Kullaberg in Skåne has a lot of culture and gastronomy to offer. Fantastic ceramics, vineyards and world-class ice cream. Tareq visits VikenTomater and cooks vegetarian ragù

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: Karlstad
programme.desc: Tareq visits sunny Karlstad! Here, food is prepared by Vänern's shores and in Värmland's deep forests. Butter-fried Zander, crepes and cooking over an open fire are on the menu.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: Best Of (Part 2)
programme.desc: Once again, Tareq Taylor looks back on some of the food adventures he has been part of in the program series Nordic Cookery. Tareq promises delicacies from all over the Nordics and meetings with fantastic people along the way.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: Lund
programme.desc: In this episode, Tareq visits Lund, a thousand-year old city in southern Sweden. Lund is surrounded by the richest farmland in the country, and we explore nearby islands and meet entrepreneurs making highly-regarded local products.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: Bornholm
programme.desc: Tareq sails out to Bornholm, a Danish island close to southern tip of Sweden. The islanders are fiercely self-sufficient and this attitude reflects in the huge number of food producers making products that are sold both locally and internationally.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: Jokkmokk
programme.desc: Far above the Arctic Circle, Tareq explores the wild country around Jokkmokk. Here, the Sami people lived from what the land provides for thousands of years. This wild cuisine is as extreme as the weather here.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: Åland
programme.desc: For hundreds of years, Åland’s shipping fleet was the envy of navies around the world, and their sea trade was encouraged by the seafood, grains and fruits that thrive on these islands. Tareq prepares recipes to reflect Åland’s unique cuisine.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: Malmö
programme.desc: Tareq is in his hometown of Malmö – Sweden’s third largest city. The food scene here is inspired by the traditional seafood dishes and the large immigrant population whose recipes have given Malmö a new energy.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5D's: A Duel with Interest
programme.desc: When a loan shark starts sinking his teeth into New Domino City, Jack decides to reel in this money-grubbing menace for good by putting his most prized possessions on the line in a duel.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5D's: The Wicked Spirits
programme.desc: When Leo and Luna decide to go exploring a nearby forest rumored to be haunted by wicked spirits, they soon discover that the rumors are all too real when a mysterious boy traps Luna in his house and challenges Leo to a duel.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5D's: French Twist: Part I
programme.desc: Yusei wakes up to find himself trapped in the back of a big rig with a bump on his head and no way out. After a mysterious tip leads Akiza to Yusei's location, the two friends soon find themselves Turbo Dueling an unfamiliar foe.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5D's: French Twist: Part II
programme.desc: As the battle between Yusei and Sherry races on, Sherry reveals some shocking secrets about the upcoming World Racing Grand Prix. Meanwhile, Akiza begins to gain a new understanding and appreciation for Turbo Dueling while riding shotgun to Yusei.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5D's: Synchro Straits
programme.desc: Before heading out to the event of the year - The World Racing Grand Prix Gala - Yusei challenges Jack to a Turbo Duel in the hopes of finding a new dueling strategy that doesn't involve the use of Synchro Monsters.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5D's: The Synchro Solution
programme.desc: A mysterious duelist named Vizor offers to show Yusei a new dueling strategy known as The Synchro Solution.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5D's: Acceleration
programme.desc: Akiza goes to get her Turbo Dueling license, but before she can drive off into the sunset, she first has to out-duel, out-maneuver and out-smart one of Sector Security's finest for her final exam.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5D's: Syd is Vicious
programme.desc: After a string of Duel Runner thefts has New Domino City on high alert, Jack Atlas decides to take justice into his own hands and ventures out in search of those responsible.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5D's: Dawn of the Duel Board: Part I
programme.desc: When a mysterious new student gives Luna a-one-of-a-kind Duel Board, Leo, trusting his instincts, steps up and tries to pull a 180 on their friendship.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5D's: Dawn of the Duel Board: Part II
programme.desc: As the Duel Board battle between Leo, Luna and the mystery duelist continues, Leo soon realizes that their mysterious opponent is actually an all-too-familiar friend.

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven: The Hidden Power!
programme.desc: After the crushing defeat of Cloister Divinity, Raimon step up to fill the hole, with Scotty the substitute helping out on Celia’s urging. The results are strange and disheartening, but also encouraging in one way.

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven: Royal Academy’s Comeback - Part 1!
programme.desc: Looks like Team Raimon have a new member, in the form of Sneaky Scotty. They’ll need all the help they can get though, because Ray Dark is back on the scene, in an unfeasibly silly submarine-based soccer stadium.

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven: Royal Academy’s Comeback Part 2!
programme.desc: Raimon are smack in the middle of a game against Royal Academy Redux, and Ray Dark has convinced its players to use any and every means to win; even if it means the destruction of their minds and bodies.

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven: The Last Wyvern Blizzard!
programme.desc: The Inazuma Caravan finally comes home to recharge their batteries and…train a whole lot more. They find out that everybody’s been training to help them, including some old enemies!

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven: Erik Eagle in Serious Trouble!
programme.desc: No sooner do they arrive home, and they’re back on the road again - this time they’re heading to Osaka where it’s rumoured that Alius Academy have a base.

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven: Dvalin’s Trap!
programme.desc: The team find that the Golden Glamour Girls’ secret training bunker under the amusement park is a great place to train, but where did it come from?

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven: Epsilon - The Toughest Battle Yet!
programme.desc: The big game against Epsilon is here, and Raimon come out with all guns blazing! Will their guns be enough to turn back the alien scourge?

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven: Grandpa’s Secret Trick!
programme.desc: Unexpected news about the existence of another David Evans notebook sends the team scurrying off to Fukuoka, where they meet one of Mark’s grandfather’s old friends, and someone who might just become Mark’s apprentice.

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven: The Other Majin the Hand!
programme.desc: The exhibition game between Raimon and Fauxshore Jr - AKA the battle of the goalies - is a knuckle biting affair. Both Mark and Darren are showing off their old moves and trying to learn new ones while a storm of shots rages around them.

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven: Seismic Earthquake Shocker!
programme.desc: Just when Raimon were feeling confident, they get a wake up call in the form of a big slap in the face from Xavier and his Genesis team. Sure, part of being a winning team is being able to cope with loss, but a loss this big?

programme.desc: Italienske ufologer utforsker spor etter romvesener i historie og folklore. Har vi blitt overvåket siden oldtiden? Dette programmet vises uten undertekster.

programme.title: Unsolved Mysteries: Belgian UFO

programme.title: UFO Hunters: UFO Storm

programme.title: The Conspiracy Show With Richard Syrett: The Roswell UFO Crash

programme.title: Alien Cyclops: The Extraordinary Case of Sagrada Familia
programme.desc: I 1963 i Brasil blir tre barn vitne til en UFO i hagen sin. En utenomjordisk kyklop kommer ned, og herr Alberto undersøker fenomenet. Dette programmet vises uten undertekster.

programme.title: UFO Hunters: Area 52
programme.desc: Area 51 is considered the ultimate top-secret facility, one that UFO investigators believe houses an extraterrestrial secret. But is there an even more secretive facility?

programme.title: Beauty and the Beast: The Reckoning"

programme.title: Beauty and the Beast: Legacies

programme.title: Beauty and the Beast: Once Upon a Time in the City of New York
programme.desc: Attacked, mutilated and left for dead, Catherine Chandler is rescued by the mysterious man-beast called Vincent.

programme.title: Beauty and the Beast: Terrible Savior
programme.desc: Witness descriptions of a vigilante lead Catherine to fear Vincent may be a killer.

programme.title: Beauty and the Beast: Siege
programme.desc: Vincent helps the residents of an apartment building defend their homes against thugs who want them out so the land can be re-developed.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Cavender is Coming
programme.desc: Cavender, an angel trying to win his wings, tries to help down-on-her-luck Agnes, who has just been fired.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Changing of the Guard
programme.desc: An elderly private school teacher wonders if his life has meant anything as he contemplates suicide on Christmas Eve and is reminded by former students that he has, indeed, had an impact on their lives.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: In Praise Of Pip
programme.desc: An alcoholic bookie regrets that he wasn't a better father to his son, Pip, critically wounded in South Vietnam. A visit to an amusement park gives them both a second chance.

programme.desc: Boxing robot "Battling Maxo" breaks down before the scheduled bout, forcing his manager to take its place.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Blue Scorpion
programme.desc: The emergence of the elusive Blue Scorpion leads anthropology professor Jeff Storck (Chris O'Dowd) to his most personal research project yet.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Blurryman
programme.desc: Writer Sophie Gelson (Zazie Beetz) is haunted by a mysterious figure. Seth Rogen and Betty Gabriel guest star.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Nightmare at 20,000 Feet
programme.desc: Mr. Wilson believes he sees a gremlin on the wing of the commercial aircraft he is taking back home... from the sanitarium, where he has been committed for six months after a mental breakdown during a similar flight.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: A Kind of a Stopwatch
programme.desc: Patrick Thomas McNulty, a long-winded and self-absorbed know-it-all, is given a fantastic device which brings literal meaning to the expression "stop the world; I want to get off."

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: The Trouble With Mary Jane
programme.desc: Two occultists are offered $50,000 if they can rid a girl of the multiple demons possessing her, but they soon find themselves in over their heads.

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: Ursa Minor
programme.desc: When Joan finds a new teddy bear in her daughter's room no one seems to know where it came from. Then night after night huge claw marks are found on the walls and the sounds of something very large can be heard moving through the house.

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: Effect And Cause
programme.desc: An artist named Kate discovers that she under unknown circumstances, has the psychic ability to live backwards, but things soon turn out for the worse when she realizes it's beyond her control.

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: Monsters In My Room
programme.desc: A little boy named Timmy tries to convince his mother and mean stepfather, that there are horrific creatures in his room, which includes a tentacled monster under his bed, a boogeyman, a saw, and a witch.

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: Comet Watch
programme.desc: Englebert Ames, an astronomer, is watching Hailey's Comet and is in for a shock when Sir Edmond Hailey himself arrives - he's been riding "his" comet all these years trying to elude Sarah, the woman pursuing him out of obsessed love.

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: Dream Girl
programme.desc: A group of people find themselves trapped in a scenario with Otto, only to discover that he is a stagehand and they are a theater group all trapped in his dream.

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: A New Lease On Life
programme.desc: A man is overjoyed to find a nice apartment with all the modern conveniences at an incredibly cheap price. The eccentric landlady asks nothing more than for the man to provide her with plenty of garbage for the disposal unit.

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: The Printer'S Devil
programme.desc: Junior Harman is a third-rate writer who discovers that his new agent, Mr. Kellaway, can make things happen for him. All it requires is a little blood - a few animals, the occasional bum...

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: The Shrine
programme.desc: A young woman, Christine, returns home to find her mother cold and distant, and living isolated from everyone else. The woman soon discovers that her mother has summoned up...Chrissie.

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: The Old Soft Shoe
programme.desc: Lingerie salesman Chester Caruso checks into a budget motel and makes a pass at a woman who is also checking in. She rejects him, but soon he wakes up in his room to find a different woman, dressed in lingerie, calling him Harry.

programme.title: JAG: Silent Service
programme.desc: Mac and Harm are having trouble relating...a result of working together under stress for so long.

programme.title: JAG: King of the Greenie Board
programme.desc: Harm is now a Tomcat division commander aboard the carrier USS Patrick Henry that is patrolling the Mediterranean near Yugoslavia.

programme.title: JAG: Rules of Engagement
programme.desc: The Russians are furious over the killing of their peacekeepers and the Navy sends Mac, Brumby, and Roberts to the Patrick Henry to conduct the court-martial of Lt. Buxton.

programme.title: JAG: True Calling
programme.desc: When a petty officer smuggles a pregnant Serbian woman aboard the carrier in order to save her from a vengeful fiancée, he's arrested and scheduled to be court-martialed.

programme.title: JAG: Psychic Warrior
programme.desc: When a Navy research project involving ESP and psychic phenomenon goes awry, resulting in the death of one of the research subjects, the Admiral in charge is court-martialed.

programme.title: The Love Boat

programme.title: The Love Boat: Rent A Romeo / Matchmaker, Matchmaker / Y'gotta Have Heart
programme.desc: Doc (Bernie Kopell) comes down with a bad case of heartache when the beautiful girl (Misty Rowe) he wants to be alone with boards ship with her ever-present sister (Vicki Lawrence).

programme.title: The Love Boat: Dumb Luck / Tres Amigos / Hey, Jealous Lover
programme.desc: A brilliant plain-Jane (Shelley Hack) becomes a fetching glamour gal with the help of Julie (Lauren Tewes), and falls in love with a man (Kevin Tighe) who has some mistaken ideas about her.

programme.desc: Isaac (Ted Lange) finds himself in a precarious position when he meets a beautiful former school chum (Bernadette Stanis) and her macho husband (Clifton Davis).

programme.title: Wings: The Bogey Men

programme.title: Wings: Marriage, Italian Style (Part 1)

programme.title: Wings: Stew In A Stew

programme.title: Wings: This Old House
programme.desc: Joe and Brian destroy their childhood house.

programme.title: Wings: Planes, Trains and Visiting Cranes
programme.desc: Cheers' Dr. Frasier Crane brings his traveling psychiatric seminar to Nantucket.

programme.title: Wings: Take My Life, Please
programme.desc: Helen takes a stab at stand-up comedy.

programme.title: Happy Days: Sight for Sore Eyes
programme.desc: After reading too many foreign car manuals, Fonzie is plagued with headaches and is forced to wear glasses for a few weeks, but fears glasses aren't cool.

programme.title: Happy Days: Fonzie Loves Pinky Part II

programme.title: Happy Days: The Apartment
programme.desc: Personality quirks begin to fray nerves after best friends Richie, Ralph, and Potsie rent an apartment together.
